name: Emily Barnes
alt: Emily Barnes with her arms folded over her head and a rust bandana at her neck, red rock towers glowing in the sun behind her.
blurb: Emily Barnes is a folk singer-songwriter with a voice that makes people stop and listen. She won the 2025 Hey Nonny Songwriting Contest, she was a New Folk finalist at the Kerrville Folk Festival, and she plays Joni Mitchell, Fleetwood Mac and Dolly Parton alongside her own songs. You can book her solo, as a duo with guitar or fiddle, or as a trio.
seo_title: Emily Barnes: folk singer-songwriter for events in Colorado
meta_description: Emily Barnes is an award-winning folk singer-songwriter who plays Joni Mitchell, Fleetwood Mac and her own songs for private events in Denver and the Colorado mountains. Book her solo, as a duo or as a trio.
identity: Emily won the 2025 Hey Nonny Songwriting Contest, and in 2026 the Colorado Music Business Organization named her one of the ten winners of its songwriting contest. She’s been a finalist at the Kerrville Folk Festival’s New Folk competition, the Red Lodge Songwriting Festival and The Acorn Songwriting Contest, too. Critics have compared her to Brandi Carlile and Joan Baez.

She grew up in Johnsonburg, New Jersey, a town of under a hundred people, writing songs on the stone steps of her family’s 200-year-old house. She’s made four albums since, and her album Mint Condition took her on a sold-out tour of the Northeast. These days she plays all over Colorado, from Denver and Boulder to Fort Collins and Grand Junction.

Last year she played 165 shows of her own music and 45 private events, so she knows how to hold a listening crowd and how to keep a cocktail hour easy and warm. She brings her own sound system, and she’s happy to plan the night around the songs you love.

ladder.bestFor: On her own, she’s a lovely fit for a ceremony, welcome drinks or a dinner where you want something a little more special than background music.

ladder.build: Emily with Chris Koza on guitar and harmony vocals, or with Anthony Manoguerra on fiddle and harmony vocals
ladder.bestFor: Two voices in harmony are hard to beat for a cocktail hour or a patio party, and the fiddle gives the duo a little country and Americana flavor.

ladder.build: Emily with both Chris Koza and Anthony Manoguerra: voice and guitar, a second guitar, fiddle and three-part harmony
ladder.bestFor: Book the trio for a fuller sound at a reception, a retreat evening or a holiday party, without drums.
